name: DogCatTrace
description: 用一套数字指纹归因流程，把候选换成狗猫品种。附对照组：与库内任何品种都无生成关系的均匀随机整数，同样拿到 81.73%~99.999% 的品种族概率。

paragraphs: This is a joke project, not a research tool. Using a formula like "similarity between number distributions + closed-set softmax" to decide whether one model was distilled from another model or model family is absurd. Similarity is not common ancestry. This repo runs that math end to end without changing a single step, so the gap is impossible to miss. The breeds, breed families, and "distillation" in here are props. The numbers are synthetic, the test subject is fictional, and none of the twenty-four breeds in the bank exist. No percentage in this repo is a statement about any real model.

DogCatTrace is a breed attribution tool. It extracts an output fingerprint from three independent integer-generation challenges, then decides the dog or cat breed family and the specific breed from a single candidate bank.
